'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Schumann LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Schumann]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Coming For Us]]
* '''Username:''' RepCom 1136
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
